lookForm.heading: Look
lookForm.subtitle: Theme this site. The preview shows your changes — nothing is live until you save.

lookForm.presetDescription: The starting point nearly every tenant picks. Sets accent hue, heading and body fonts, radius, and density.
lookForm.accentHueDescription: Only the hue changes — lightness & chroma are fixed (OKLCH), so contrast stays WCAG-verified.
lookForm.accentHueInaccessible: This hue doesn't keep body text readable on its tinted surfaces, so the site would replace it. Choose another hue.
lookForm.logoHueDescription: Tints the wordmark's tonal steps (--logo-1/2/3). Follows the accent hue unless you set it.
lookForm.brandImagesDescription: Stored in Vercel Blob — no on-the-fly transforms, so what you upload is what ships.
lookForm.logoFieldHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP, or SVG · falls back to the polygon wordmark
lookForm.faviconFieldHint: Pre-cropped square, please — Blob can't crop it for you (an SVG's viewBox counts as its shape). Non-square uploads are rejected.
lookForm.cardStyleDescription: How post, topic and quote cards are framed across the site.

provisioningStatusView.startErrorNotFound: Couldn't find this tenant — refresh the page and try again.
provisioningStatusView.startErrorArchived: This tenant is archived; provisioning can't be started.

permission.headline: Missing permission to complete this step
permission.body: The provisioning credentials aren't allowed to do what this step needs — often inviting a project member or granting access. It may need to be finished manually in the Sanity Manage or Vercel dashboard.
permission.nextStep: Grant the missing permission, then retry.

duplicate.headline: Already in use by another tenant
duplicate.body: Something this step is trying to create — a project handle, an email invite, or a domain — is already claimed elsewhere.

network.headline: Couldn't reach the provisioning service
network.body: The request to Sanity or Vercel timed out or the connection dropped before finishing. This is often temporary.

unknown.headline: This step failed
unknown.body: Provisioning hit an error that isn't recognized yet. The technical details below may help diagnose it.
unknown.nextStep: Retry, or check the technical details before asking for help.

provisioningStatusView.runStartedPending: Waiting for the run to start…

permission.headline: Missing permission to complete this step
permission.body: The teardown credentials aren't allowed to do what this step needs — often revoking a token or removing a project member. It may need to be finished manually in the Sanity Manage or Vercel dashboard.
permission.nextStep: Grant the missing permission, then re-dispatch teardown.

duplicate.headline: Already in use elsewhere
duplicate.body: Something this step is trying to remove or reassign — a domain mapping, a token — is already claimed or referenced elsewhere.
duplicate.nextStep: Resolve the conflict, then re-dispatch teardown.

network.headline: Couldn't reach the teardown service
network.body: The request to Sanity or Vercel timed out or the connection dropped before finishing. This is often temporary.
network.nextStep: Wait a moment, then re-dispatch teardown.

unknown.headline: This step failed
unknown.body: Teardown hit an error that isn't recognized yet. The technical details below may help diagnose it.
unknown.nextStep: Re-dispatch teardown, or check the technical details before asking for help.

archivedTenantNotice.description: Deprovisioned {date}. Everything on these pages is read-only.

deprovisionTenantControl.description: Removes the tenant's custom domain, deletes its Studio project, and archives its Sanity project so it stops billing rather than deleting it. The tenant row itself is archived, not deleted. This cannot be undone.
deprovisionTenantControl.inProgressHint: A deprovisioning run is already in progress for this tenant.
deprovisionTenantControl.dialogDescription: This dispatches deprovision-tenant.yml, which tears down every provisioned resource for this tenant. Type the tenant's name to confirm.
deprovisionTenantControl.confirmHint: Must match the tenant's name exactly.
deprovisionTenantControl.dryRunLabel: Dry run (preview only, nothing is deleted)
deprovisionTenantControl.deleteDescription: Permanently removes this tenant and every dependent row (memberships, subscribers, bookmarks, domains, site config) from the database. This cannot be undone, and releases its domain for reuse.
deprovisionTenantControl.deleteDialogDescription: This permanently deletes the tenant row and everything that depends on it. Type the tenant's name to confirm.
deprovisionTenantControl.deleteConfirmHint: Must match the tenant's name exactly.

reactivateTenantControl.description: Brings an archived tenant back online by re-running provisioning: it un-archives the tenant row and its Sanity project, re-maps the custom domain, and recreates the revalidation webhook. Use this instead of deleting a tenant that was deprovisioned by mistake.
reactivateTenantControl.dialogDescription: This dispatches provision-tenant.yml, which restores every provisioned resource for this tenant. Type the tenant's name to confirm.
reactivateTenantControl.confirmHint: Must match the tenant's name exactly.
